notes: The contact card is rebuilt to match the menu that already opens from the gear in a chat header, because the version that shipped yesterday looked like it came from a different app — a full-bleed square photo filling three quarters of the screen above rows in a style used nowhere else. It now uses the same grip, the same rounded block for the header, the same hairline-separated rows with their counts on the right. Their picture is a round avatar beside the name, the way avatars look everywhere else in the app, and tapping it still opens it full size. The card is half the height it was, so it covers less of the conversation behind it. This also fixes a real fault that shipped with it: the new card defined its own functions and its own scrim styling under names the app was already using, which silently broke the chat options menu — tapping the gear in a chat header did nothing at all on the previous build. Both now share the one sheet, so there is nothing left to collide.
